questions.question: If a juvenile commits a driving offence under the MV Act, until what age is the juvenile barred from getting a licence?
questions.explanation: Section 199A also holds the guardian or owner guilty (up to 3 years and ₹25,000 fine) and cancels the vehicle's registration.
